articles.title: Adley Rutschman returns to Baltimore, homers twice in Red Sox win
articles.description: Orioles fans welcomed Rutschman with a standing ovation. Then he hit home runs in the first and sixth innings.

articles.title: With Red Sox off to Baltimore, Chad Tracy gets to revisit the biggest day of his career
articles.description: More than four months after being named interim manager, Tracy has a hard time remembering his first day on the job at Camden Yards.

articles.title: Mariners crush Red Sox rookie called up to fill in for Sonny Gray
articles.description: "He struggled," Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy said of rookie right-hander Jedixson Paez.

articles.title: Home-plate umpire Will Little, hit with foul ball, exits Red Sox-Mariners game
articles.description: The umpire was hit squarely in the neck guard, dislodging the guard from his face mask.

articles.title: Trevor Story, after nearly four months on sidelines, gives Red Sox walk-off win in extras
articles.description: "It was special for sure,” Story said. “It’s a lot of work behind the scenes and a lot of work from a lot of different people."

articles.title: Red Sox rookie Payton Tolle is a hugger. Dominic Canzone just found that out
articles.description: "It just kind of happened," Tolle said afterward. "I was right there in front of him, like, 'Bring it in for the big one.’"

articles.title: MLB Power Rankings: A top-5 shake-up; How do each team's trade deadline moves look now?

articles.title: Red Sox lose top bat Willson Contreras to injured list; Sonny Gray's next start pushed back
articles.description: Contreras left Sunday's game in New York with a sore hamstring. Mickey Gaspar re-joins the Boston roster in Contreras' place.

articles.title: Citing backlash, broadcaster Will Flemming apologizes after calling for Red Sox-Yankees fight
articles.description: "These rivalry games get me fired up; I apologize for letting the emotion of the moment get the best of me," Will Flemming wrote on X.

articles.title: Broadcaster says Red Sox pitcher should drill Yankees’ Austin Wells, fight Jazz Chisholm Jr.
articles.description: Red Sox play-by-play man Will Flemming took exception to Jazz Chisholm Jr. stealing two bases with Yankees up six runs in eighth.

articles.title: Red Sox furious after controversial no-catch call in Yankees rout
articles.description: With playoff implications looming large for Boston, the no-catch call was particularly frustrating for the Red Sox.

articles.title: Why Roman Anthony, Trevor Story returning led to a 'bittersweet' situation for Chad Tracy

articles.title: Trevor Story, Roman Anthony to rejoin Red Sox ahead of key Yankees showdown
articles.description: Boston gets offensive reinforcements as the AL wild-card race remains tight.

articles.title: Adley Rutschman picks up 3 hits, Jake Bennett dazzles in important win over Yankees
articles.description: Rutschman's all-around game, including catching Bennett for six scoreless, spurred Boston to a win in the first game of a key doubleheader.

articles.title: Chad Tracy managed like October in a loss to Yankees with playoff seeding on the line
articles.description: Despite the interim manager's aggressiveness, Boston's offense couldn't break through during a pitchers' duel in the Bronx.

articles.title: The Red Sox last faced the Yankees in June. They're a wildly different team now
articles.description: The Red Sox looked like a last place team when they started a series against the Yankees in late June. They've been red-hot ever since.
